title: Judge Rejects Trump Officials’ Move to Challenge Alaska Senate Election
partialText: The ruling dismisses the Department of Justice’s lawsuit that pre-emptively contested the results of a race that includes two candidates named Daniel Sullivan.

title: This Republican Wants Voters to Consider a Post-Trump World
partialText: John E. Sununu, the Republican Senate candidate in New Hampshire, has the president’s endorsement but is keeping him at arm’s length.

title: Stylish Looks From the New York City Marathon
partialText: A pasta-loving runner and a woman celebrating a birthday were among the marathoners, some of whom were extending their Halloween festivities into race day.

title: Here Are Some of the Celebrities Running in the NYC Marathon
partialText: Actors, reality stars and athletes are among those in the mass of runners. The comedian Tracy Morgan is the event’s grand marshal.

title: Gaffes and Men’s Bodies: Analysis of Trump’s Speeches at Age 80
partialText: A Times review of the president’s public speeches finds that he is more profane, more absolutist, longer-winded and less coherent than he was in 2016.

title: Netanyahu’s Bid to Stay in Power Will Test His Political Savvy
partialText: After losing ground in Israel’s election, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu must draw on decades of political capital and reckon with old foes if he is to build a governing coalition.

title: Where Do Israel’s Arab Parties Stand?
partialText: Having won a record 19 seats in Israel’s Parliament, the two Arab-led parties say they want to work with opposition factions to take down the Netanyahu government.

title: The Rise, Fall and Rise of Curtis Malone, D.C. Basketball Power Broker
partialText: Curtis Malone ran a basketball powerhouse in Washington, D.C., before going to prison for drug dealing. Now he wants back in the game.

title: Trump Has Found the Attorney General of His Dreams
partialText: The Department of Justice is in a state of moral collapse.

title: What a Decade of Pizzagate Has Done to America
partialText: A decade after the Pizzagate theory began, the Epstein files give the conspiracy theory a new life.

title: How Marathons Changed

title: Senator Chris Murphy Is ‘Awake and Alert’ After Suffering a Stroke
partialText: The Connecticut senator, who has been campaigning for fellow Democrats, has been viewed as a potential candidate for president in 2028.
